maddeler.e:
ينتبهون (form VIII)
# يَنْتَبِهُونَ (yantabihūna) /jan.ta.bi.huː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِنْتَبَهَ (intabaha)
# يُنْتَبَهُونَ (yuntabahūna) /jun.ta.ba.huː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَبَهَ (intabaha)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
